concept.title: Affordable activities for a baby's development
concept.shortdesc: As a parent on maternity leave, I need affordable activities that stimulate my baby's development, so that I can give her a good start without spending much.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-004). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Wants things to do with the baby that are cheap or free.
A good result: Free or low-cost sessions suitable for the baby's age, with price shown.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: cheap things to do with a 4 month old

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
